name: Jordan Lee
headline: Product Manager at Northwind Labs
quote: Alex is the engineer you want on a small team. They take a vague problem, ask the right questions, and come back with something that works and is easy to change later. During our dashboard rebuild Alex also mentored two junior developers, reviewed every pull request with patience, and still shipped the performance work ahead of schedule. I would happily work with Alex again on any product.
